scope: Active formal phases and completed parent budgets. All token budgets are main CE; independent indexer budgets excluded. Budget completion does not establish generation capability.
training_curve_sampling: For each active phase: first, every logged step divisible by 250, and latest training row; all validation records through capture retained. Completed parent phase summaries supplement the 2026-09-12 snapshot.
throughput_scope: Arithmetic mean of up to the latest 20 logged CE update rates; excludes evaluation, checkpoint saves and waiting. Different phases and modalities are not performance-equivalent.
eta_scope: Remaining current-phase optimizer updates only. No ETA published for a recovered run with fewer than 20 logged throughput samples.
